summary: United Fire Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 annual meeting, where all director nominees were elected, auditor Ernst & Young was ratified, executive compensation was approved, and a stock plan amendment was passed. It also disclosed a regular quarterly dividend of $0.20 per share and an extension of an existing share repurchase program. These are routine corporate governance and capital allocation actions, not constituting a special situation such as a going-private or restructuring event. No special-situation catalyst is present; the filing is ordinary.
